title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_tagebuch_eines_super_kriegers_by_cube_kid_0he3p (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_tagebuch_eines_super_kriegers_by_cube_kid_0he3p' contains malicious code that fully compromises any computer on which it is installed or running. The compromise includes potential unauthorized access to secrets and keys stored on the affected system. Immediate removal of the package is advised, but due to the extent of the compromise, removing the package alone may not eliminate all malicious software. Secrets and keys should be rotated from a different, uncompromised computer to mitigate risk.
